items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Sergeant Garr in the Air Force, yeah, he said that to me.

ctx.x: Someone once said to you, “Jazz is okay but it ain’t got no words.”
Sergeant Garr in the Air Force, yeah, he said that to me. He’s right.
